You signed in to Acme Support through single sign-on

Your Yuva account ayse@example.com signed in to the workspace Acme Support through its identity
provider for the first time. That sign-in works only in Acme Support; your other workspaces still
need a code or a passkey.

If this was not you, tell the owners of Acme Support and your IT team at once: whoever runs that
identity provider can sign in as you in Acme Support.
